_README: Same-day atmospheric state at the observing site. All values retrieved from operational analyses/forecasts on 2026-08-12, not assumed.

sources.aerosol: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) global/European forecast, served via the Open-Meteo Air Quality API (https://air-quality-api.open-meteo.com/v1/air-quality). Variable: aerosol_optical_depth (550 nm).
sources.meteo: ECMWF IFS / DWD ICON forecast served via the Open-Meteo Forecast API (https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast). Variables: total_column_integrated_water_vapour, surface_pressure, temperature_2m, relative_humidity_2m, cloud_cover*, visibility.
sources.ozone: WOUDC (World Ozone and UV Radiation Data Centre) OGC API, collection 'totalozone', station_id 411 Zaragoza, contributor AEMET. Full 7711-record series downloaded and filtered locally. https://api.woudc.org/collections/totalozone/items?station_id=411

adopted_for_eclipse_window.aod500_note: Converted from the CAMS 550 nm value with the Angstrom law AOD(500) = AOD(550) * (550/500)^alpha_A using alpha_A = 1.14, the default Angstrom exponent of the Bird & Riordan (1984) SPECTRL2 model. Sensitivity to alpha_A in [0.8, 1.6] is reported in the paper.
adopted_for_eclipse_window.precipitable_water_note: TCWV 27.6 kg m^-2 at 18:00 UTC; 1 kg m^-2 of column water = 0.1 cm of precipitable water by definition (rho_water = 1000 kg m^-3).
adopted_for_eclipse_window.ozone_note: Measured climatology, no longer assumed. WOUDC station 411 (Zaragoza, GAW ZAR), Brewer MKIV spectrophotometer operated by AEMET, 41.628 N 0.912 W, 136 km from the site and at essentially the same latitude. Daily total column over the 8-16 August window across 2001-2024: n = 189 days, mean 310.9 DU, sd 13.8 DU. The whole-August set (n = 630) gives 309.3 +- 12.4 DU, range 280.2-364.2. Adopted value 0.3109 atm-cm. Sensitivity: moving from the previously assumed 0.300 atm-cm to this measured value changes the direct beam by -0.09 % and the blue-weighted corneal irradiance by -0.03 %; spanning the full historical range 280-364 DU changes them by under 0.7 %. Ozone is therefore confirmed to be irrelevant to every conclusion in this study, which is now demonstrated rather than asserted.
adopted_for_eclipse_window.ground_albedo_note: Dry Mediterranean scrub/vineyard terrain. Affects only the diffuse/ground-reflected component, never the direct beam that a lens focuses or an eye fixates; all safety conclusions in this paper rest on the direct beam.
